Data Protection Enforcement & GDPR Compliance

Compliance Automation

Automated GDPR compliance checks validating data processing records, DPIAs, and lawful bases against Article 5-6 requirements.

NLP parsing of privacy notices, data processing agreements, and legitimate interest assessments against ICO guidance.
